selection_note: UPSTREAM UPGRADE BATCH 22, explicit operator size ten. Chose ten highest reviewed_at, distinct, included Index S1=A/S2=C assessments not claimed by integrated batches 01-21 (115 sources) or present open Upstream PR source claims. Exact canonical Index main frozen; prospective hypotheses checkpointed before current external code/issue inspection at 441d7675, with a source-ref transcription-only correction at 91e316b. These are questions, not proven product defects, runner receipts or third-party publication grants.

candidates.finding: Probe whether stale completion or expiration can reuse an active session pool slot despite the documented affinity and capacity checks.
candidates.screening_result: At current main the service manager uses a shared async lock, active-request-count checks and pending-expiration flush, and rechecks inflight before idle/reclaim; no source-supported unsafe expiry/reassignment was confirmed. This is a static negative native-fit screen, not a test execution.

candidates.finding: Probe whether two simultaneous first deliveries with the same group, run and destination key launch duplicate crews before a durable reservation.
candidates.screening_result: The exact assessed crew_step_runner.go path is absent on current main, and current code search has no RunCrewStep symbol. A separate scheduled crew chat route exists, but the preregistered old delivery-key mechanism does not presently target that route; no bug attributed, no patch.

candidates.finding: Probe whether a late completion racing lease expiration and retry can release capacity twice or overwrite the succeeding result.
candidates.screening_result: Current complete/reconcile use the same scheduler lock. Late lease IDs go to stale history handling; _release_lease removes the active lease and reserved budget once. Predicted double release/late overwrite was not corroborated by first-party code; no tests claimed.

candidates.finding: Probe whether a symlink alias and its real target can evade the parallel shared-write scope exclusion rule in a supported workspace.
candidates.screening_result: Current scope_overlaps handles lexical roots/prefixes, while worktree paths separately resolve symlinks. Whether a symlink-alias write claim is admitted as a valid shared-workspace scope is not settled by the visible contract; no native first-party counterexample/repro was run.
candidates.blocker: Need supported first-party symlink-aliased shared write-scope fixture and policy expectation before changing claim semantics.

candidates.finding: Probe whether fallback from a failed default worktree allocation launches a simultaneous mutating task into the shared project root.
candidates.screening_result: First-party default worktree setup catches error and intentionally falls back to root. Concurrent root reuse is plausible, but no pinned two-worker failure or accepted fail-closed policy for this deliberate nonfatal fallback is shown. Contributor rules also require CLA and test-level disclosure.
candidates.blocker: Need native concurrent fallback reproduction and maintainer product decision on refusing nonfatal shared-root execution; no safe patch admission yet.

candidates.finding: Probe whether concurrent first requests using one convid each create a distinct long-lived kernel and leak/overwrite the session binding.
candidates.screening_result: Exact source handler permits two concurrent new requests for the same convid to create two gateways before publishing conv_id_to_kernel. Separately dispatched dev-alpha-2 SSH runner session 7c40d6d9-65a4-454e-b0ca-6d6e2b1668ac, Python 3.12.3 / Tornado 6.5.2, matched native HTTP test: baseline 1/2 PASS and a duplicate-gateway FAIL; patched 2/2 PASS, independent-conversation concurrency preserved; compileall/diff-check PASS. No live Docker, model or third-party publication. Origin checkpoint 441d7675 precedes target-code inspection.
candidates.observed_native_change: Separate dev-alpha-2 monitored SSH runner 7c40d6d9-65a4-454e-b0ca-6d6e2b1668ac on exact first-party CodeAct d607f56, native Tornado HTTP handler / stubbed Jupyter backend. Matched Python unittest 2 cases: before 1 PASS/1 FAIL (duplicate gateway); after fix 2/2 PASS, compileall and git diff --check PASS. Exact source, patch hashes, runtime and log retention in pilots/codeact-s2/INDEPENDENT_HOST_RECEIPT_2026-11-09.md.

candidates.finding: Probe whether losing-session continuation settlement repeated after partial delivery enqueues the same already accepted command twice.
candidates.screening_result: Settlement delegates the losing send to resumeSessionInbox; retry and owner-hook semantics are supplied by Workflow SDK resumeCurrentOwner. No exact partial-delivery replay fixture or duplicate effect established; cannot claim a native defect from a possible workflow retry.
candidates.blocker: Need pinned first-party Workflow SDK duplicate/partial-delivery retry fixture and acceptance semantics for a losing continuation command.

candidates.finding: Probe whether simultaneous start requests to an idle task pass admission and create two live task workers before the occupancy marker persists.
candidates.screening_result: Current first-party engineering contract documents one-live-run-per-task partial unique index and transaction-local active-run probe, with already_running refusal for retry. The pre-registered double-live-start mechanism is already guarded; distinct post-completion retries are intentionally a separate idempotency concern.

candidates.finding: Probe whether a candidate mutation begun before lease revocation commits after another identity claims the same refinement state.
candidates.screening_result: The assessed Meta candidate lease protocol is retired and current CLI/project operation protocol does not accept those candidate lease methods. The preregistered stale candidate-lease write is not an active product path; other device/training leases are not retroactive matches.

candidates.finding: Probe whether two concurrent triggers of an overlap_policy=skip schedule both observe no active session and launch duplicate runs.
candidates.screening_result: The scheduler already serializes due ticks across replicas using a distributed singleton NewNonBlockingLock and sequential processSchedule. overlap_policy=skip guards its scheduled create route; manual Trigger is outside that path. No concurrent scheduled-tick violation established.
